grades.quote: When an exception is triggered, if the exception type is neither a TLB refill exception nor a machine error exception, the `PC` of the instruction that triggered the exception will be recorded in this register.
grades.reason: This is the ERA register definition. It says the PC of the instruction that triggered the exception is recorded when an exception occurs. It also gives the exceptions that don't use it (TLB refill and machine error) and the LA64 32-bit address mode behavior. The register's name, Exception Return Address, shows it is used as the return address.
